name: monyema
description: MoneyMa - จัดการการเงินส่วนตัว
author: Your Name

scripts.build:mobile: REACT_APP_VERSION=$npm_package_version REACT_APP_MOBILE_BUILD=true GENERATE_SOURCEMAP=false react-scripts build && node scripts/strip-web-only-assets.js
scripts.build-android: node scripts/patch-android-plugins.js && npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync-android: npm run build:mobile && npx cap copy android
scripts.build-android-release: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build-ios: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build-ios-debug-sim: xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -derivedDataPath /tmp/pfm-ios-debug-sim build
scripts.build-ios-release: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -allowProvisioningUpdates -derivedDataPath /tmp/pfm-ios-release-sign build
scripts.archive-ios: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -allowProvisioningUpdates -archivePath /tmp/pfm-ios-archives/MoneyMa.xcarchive archive
